name: branding-oversized-year-numerals-logo-portfolio-cover
title: Grey cover with giant cropped year numerals and a copyright mark
whatItIs: A mid-grey slide with tiny caps title 'SELECTED LOGOS, FORMS & MARKS' at the top, and giant white bold numerals '26 © 20' cropped by the edges with a circled-c symbol in the middle. 'VOL.02' sits at the bottom left.
whatItMeans: Confident and editorial; the copyright glyph doubles as a cover graphic and a joke on ownership.
techniques: Use a giant symbol (©) as the graphic centre of a cover.
Crop huge numerals off the frame.
Use a flat grey field to keep white type crisp.
Frame with tiny caps labels at the corners.

vocabulary.definition: The circled C used as a graphic.
Text naming an edition of a portfolio.
